name: Login Notification
description: Emails a user when their account logs in, with a one-time "close all sessions" link (compromise-detection).
project_description:
LoginNotification Module

 Features 
 The Login Notification module allows site users to receive an email notification every time they log in. To activate this feature, check the "Login notification" field on the user profile page. This will send an email containing a link to log out, which can be used to terminate the session if the login was not made by the genuine user.

 Post-Installation 
 To activate this feature, check the "Login notification" field on the user profile page.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires SMTP module or any other mailing module.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/smtp
